folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B289: procedural creation, resources and retained identity
folds.body:
The full [P6 creation audit](gm/dispatch/procgen-2026-10-13/p6/LIVE_AUDIT.md), [P8 resource audit](gm/dispatch/procgen-2026-10-13/p8/LIVE_AUDIT.md), [P38 source audit](gm/dispatch/procgen-2026-10-13/p38/SOURCE_AUDIT.md) and [P39 source audit](gm/dispatch/procgen-2026-10-13/p39/SOURCE_AUDIT.md) supply selected source-era support and real extension pressures. Every row was read, including P38 F7b and its P34 refresh; linked code and source atlases are not newly reviewed by this fold. Their moving HEADs/dirty hashes identify snapshots, not current ownership or live behavior.

P6 F1–F14 retain useful native entry points: recipe chance/quality and exact material substitution; authored equipment, food and treatments; one Springsteel profile with a real technique effect; body-fit/worn-stat definitions; reversible actual apparatus; wear/repair; home fixtures; played crop growth; and learned versus executable techniques. Catalogue filling is not a recipe generator, template lookup does not admit arbitrary instance metadata, and a notebook is not personal fuel. A generated output must reach its actual equipment/food/treatment/work consumer. Broader ratios, process graphs, inks, enchantments, body adapters and persistent structure need only the selected actual implementation, without forcing wear or hunger into ordinary play.

P8 F1–F16 distinguish equipped tool presence from useful tool/technique performance, quality from a material assay, authored regional yield from a finite deposit or ecology, existing saturation from actual merchant cargo, and seasons on jobs from the separately checked gathering path. The latter is a source risk, not a newly reproduced defect. A harvested crop may be exhausted while a plot can be replanted; a newly paid harvest or lawful source remains possible. Stored item size is not automatically pack mass. Shipment manifests already exercise real reservation/cancel ownership. The earlier no-partitioned-carcass observation is qualified by the later [HV1 report and fold](gm/dispatch/harvest-modules-2026-10-14/PLAN.md), whose unsupported species/consumers remain explicit. No blanket bone-as-metal chemistry or actual renewable tapping follows from an authored exception.

P38/P39 retain exact mixture identity and retention. Profiles, process, ordered fractions, scale/mass and revision distinguish products; similar dose is not stack equivalence. Exact-product observation is not an ingredient-wide hidden-property assay or every NPC's body response. Long hidden-composition keys need observer-safe handles rather than public truth leakage. A consumed vial can still be referenced by its active exposure; retention follows actual effects, jobs, methods, holders and obligations, not merely current inventory count. One hero oral law, whole-pack input and one due job do not establish every route/body/amount/actor adapter or catch-up equivalence. Schedule/standing-order extensions must preserve actual remaining work and returned time.

The source-era mixture plan writes one validated owner/stock/money envelope before publication. Attach new consequential receipts to that transaction, not a later independent write. Native and actor money/stock remain their actual owners. Refs qualify world/instance/actor and direction; equal names in household/generated/simulation providers do not establish one identity. Saved future birth/marriage/death rows are scheduled facts, not already lived events. Current knowledge overwrites and lossy memories cannot reconstruct contradictory claims or full prior conversations. Preserve enough cause/basis when that consumer needs it, without replacing every small fact with a universal ledger.

P34's evolving retained history raised concrete bounded questions: array-ref query support, all-request pins, closed-event references still checked after open-only pinning, eviction of operation lookup protection and differing-payload retry, native delta coverage and literal S2 versus S4 parent inheritance. These are selected source hazards with caller-dependent consequences, not reproduced current save failures. Pins should preserve actionable obligations and release only through their owning consumer; decorative refs need not pin an entire visit forever. The proposed consolidation schemas/queries/budgets are not implemented merely because P38/P39 recommend them. Whole-envelope/backup fit matters; the old four-MiB UTF-16-origin guard is not a free-standing file-size promise or evidence of atomic chunks/quarantine.

Later P38/P39 main ancestry/import observations qualify P6/P8 earlier unmerged wording for that date, while served rebuilt integration stays separate. P39 correctly distinguishes a 512-boundary remainder from cooperative CPU yielding: synchronously draining it is not a frame budget. Its P40 refresh attributes synthetic receipt-eviction, target-delta, locale-order and late-poll findings without claiming another reproduction. Preserve source findings, conditional failure scenarios and current owner routing, not duplicate standalone engines. Existing registry/listed-pack fetch does not establish an automatic descriptor system or lazy world loading. The original P26–P29 crafting aliases were replaced by CR1–CR4; story P26–P28 remain distinct and no P29 report is invented. No current code, schema, runtime/persistence test or primary material/source law is newly verified here.
